proposals.title: Independent Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt policy requiring the Board Chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, phased in at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The Board recommends you vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Special Shareholder Meetings
proposals.topic_summary: Amend governing documents so holders of 10% of outstanding stock can call a special shareholder meeting without court approval.
proposals.evidence: The Board believes it is important for shareholders to have the right to call a special shareholder meeting

proposals.title: Report on Scenario Analysis
proposals.topic_summary: Issue an audited report on whether and how a significant reduction in fossil fuel demand in the IEA Net Zero 2050 scenario would affect financial position and assumptions.
proposals.evidence: the Board believes the requested audited report is unnecessary.

proposals.title: Report on Environmental Expenditures
proposals.topic_summary: Publish annual report of costs and actual benefits from voluntary environment-related activities exceeding compliance requirements.
proposals.evidence: The Board believes the proposal, therefore, is unnecessary.

proposals.title: Report on Political Contributions
proposals.topic_summary: Prepare semiannual report disclosing policies and electoral contributions and expenditures, including indirect spending through trade associations and 501(c)(4) groups.
proposals.evidence: In the Board's view, this proposal is unnecessary.

proposals.title: Report on Lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Prepare annual report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying and grassroots communications policies, payments, and oversight.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends voting against this proposal.

proposals.title: Report on Climate Lobbying
proposals.topic_summary: Evaluate and report whether direct and trade association lobbying aligns with Paris Agreement goals and how misalignment risks are mitigated.
proposals.evidence: Considering the above, the Board believes the elements of this proposal have already been met or surpassed, and it is therefore unnecessary.
